## Load Packages, Data and PCA Plot

```{r}
setwd("~/miniBulk_EC")
library(ggplot2)
library(genefilter)

load("EC.RNAseq.Manuscript.RData")

rowVariance_combine <- rowVars(EC.TPM.gene)
names(rowVariance_combine) <- rownames(EC.TPM.gene)
rowVariance_combine <- rowVariance_combine[!grepl("^Rp|^mt-|^Gm", names(rowVariance_combine))]
selected_Rows_combine <- names(sort(rowVariance_combine, decreasing = T)[1:1000])
cx_combine <- sweep(t(EC.TPM.gene[selected_Rows_combine, ]), 2, colMeans(t(EC.TPM.gene[selected_Rows_combine, ])))
sv_combine <- svd(cx_combine)
sv_combine$d^2/sum(sv_combine$d^2) # variance explained
HTseq.EC.ann$PC1_TPM <- sv_combine$u[,1]
HTseq.EC.ann$PC2_TPM <- sv_combine$u[,2]

combine_EC_pca <- ggplot(HTseq.EC.ann) + geom_point(aes(x=PC1_TPM, y=PC2_TPM, fill=Tissue, shape=TumorModel), colour="#000000", size=6) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#AC0000","#AC0000", "#57A5E5")) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,22)) + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.border=element_blank(), axis.line.x=element_line(colour="black"), axis.line.y=element_line(colour="black")) + coord_fixed(ratio=2.621423/4.82307)
ggsave("~/combine_EC_pca_2.pdf", combine_EC_pca, width=6.28, height=6.28, units="in", useDingbats=FALSE)
```

## Visualize EC signature gene expression

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pheatmap)
EC_sig1 <- read.csv("EC_signatures.csv", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
EC_sig1$Gene <- paste0(substr(EC_sig1$Gene, 1, 1), tolower(substr(EC_sig1$Gene, 2, nchar(EC_sig1$Gene))))
EC_sig1 <- EC_sig1[EC_sig1$Gene %in% rownames(EC.TPM.gene), ]

EC_sig2 <- read.csv("EC_signatures2.csv", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
EC_sig2$Gene <- paste0(substr(EC_sig2$Gene, 1, 1), tolower(substr(EC_sig2$Gene, 2, nchar(EC_sig2$Gene))))
EC_sig2 <- EC_sig2[EC_sig2$Gene %in% rownames(EC.TPM.gene), ]

LSCE_genes <- intersect(EC_sig1$Gene[EC_sig1$Group=="LSEC"], EC_sig2$Gene[EC_sig2$Group=="LSEC"])
Immune_genes <- intersect(EC_sig1$Gene[EC_sig1$Group=="Inflammatory-related"], EC_sig2$Gene[EC_sig2$Group=="Immunomudulation"])

color_pal <- c(rep("#4575B4", 10), colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n=7, name="RdYlBu")))(80), rep("#D73027", 10))
pheatmap(EC.TPM.gene[LSCE_genes, HTseq.EC.ann$TumorModel=="LvMet"], scale = "row", clustering_distance_rows="correlation", clustering_distance_cols="correlation")
pheatmap(EC.TPM.gene[LSCE_genes, HTseq.EC.ann$TumorModel=="HCC"], scale = "row", clustering_distance_rows="correlation", clustering_distance_cols="correlation")
pheatmap(t(EC.TPM.gene[LSCE_genes, ]), scale = "column", clustering_distance_rows="correlation", clustering_distance_cols="correlation")

pheatmap(EC.TPM.gene[Immune_genes, HTseq.EC.ann$TumorModel=="LvMet"], scale = "row", clustering_distance_rows="correlation", clustering_distance_cols="correlation")
pheatmap(EC.TPM.gene[Immune_genes, HTseq.EC.ann$TumorModel=="HCC"], scale = "row", clustering_distance_rows="correlation", clustering_distance_cols="correlation")
pheatmap(EC.TPM.gene[Immune_genes, ], scale = "row", clustering_distance_rows="correlation", clustering_distance_cols="correlation")


pheatmap(EC.TPM.gene[EC_sig$Gene, HTseq.EC.ann$TumorModel=="HCC"], scale = "row", annotation_row=data.frame(GeneClass=EC_sig$Group), annotation_colors=list(GeneClass=c(`LSEC`="#000000", `ECM-related`="#555555", `ECM-related`="#999999")))
```

## Gene Ontology

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(limma)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(gghalves)

sample_vector <- list.files("HTseq_count/") ## Modify DIR
template.data <- read.delim(paste0("HTseq_count/", HTseq.EC.ann$fileName[1]), row.names=1, header=FALSE)

EC.HTseq <- matrix(NA, nrow=nrow(template.data), ncol=length(sample_vector), dimnames=list(rownames(template.data), HTseq.EC.ann$shortName))

for(i in 1:length(sample_vector)) {
  file_i <- read.delim(paste0("HTseq_count/", HTseq.EC.ann$fileName[i]), row.names=1, header=FALSE)
  print(all.equal(rownames(template.data), rownames(file_i)))
  if (all.equal(rownames(template.data), rownames(file_i))) {
    EC.HTseq[, HTseq.EC.ann$shortName[i]] <- file_i[, "V2"]
  }
}

rownames(EC.HTseq) <- sub("\\..+", "", rownames(EC.HTseq))

ID_convert <- read.table("Ensembl_Gene_Converter.txt", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

sample.probe.ms <- rownames(EC.HTseq)[rownames(EC.HTseq) %in% ID_convert$ensembl_ID]
ID_convert <- ID_convert[ID_convert$ensembl_ID %in% sample.probe.ms, ]
genenames.ms <- unique(ID_convert$mgi_symbol[ID_convert$ensembl_ID %in% sample.probe.ms])


EC.HTseq.gene <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(genenames.ms), ncol=ncol(EC.HTseq), dimnames = list(genenames.ms, colnames(EC.HTseq)))


for(g in genenames.ms) {
  probes <- as.character(ID_convert$ensembl_ID[ID_convert$mgi_symbol==g])
  if(length(probes)==1) {
    EC.HTseq.gene[g, ] <- EC.HTseq[probes, ]
  }
  else{
    EC.HTseq.gene[g, ] <- apply(EC.HTseq[probes, ], 2, max)
  }
}


EC.HTseq.dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(EC.HTseq.gene, colData=HTseq.EC.ann, design= ~ Tissue2)
EC.HTseq.dds <- DESeq(EC.HTseq.dds)

EC.HTseq.rld <- rlog(EC.HTseq.dds)

plotPCA(EC.HTseq.rld, intgroup=c("TumorModel", "Tissue"))
```

## Differential Gene Expression Analysis

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(limma)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(gghalves)

load("~/miniBulk_EC/EC.miniBulkRNAseq.RData")
EC.HTseq.rld <- rlog(EC.HTseq.dds)

PROJECT.design <- model.matrix(~ 1 + Tissue2, data=HTseq.EC.ann)

# PROJECT.fitlimma <- lmFit(log2(EC.TPM.gene+1), PROJECT.design)
PROJECT.fitlimma <- lmFit(log2(EC.TPM.gene+1), PROJECT.design)
PROJECT.fitbayes <- eBayes(PROJECT.fitlimma)
DE_gene_table <- topTable(PROJECT.fitbayes, adjust="BH", number=nrow(EC.TPM.gene))

DE_gene_table["Esm1",]
```

## GSEA

```{r}
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

geneList <- DE_gene_table$logFC
names(geneList) <- rownames(DE_gene_table)
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

EC_gseGO <- gseGO(geneList=geneList, keyType="SYMBOL", OrgDb=org.Mm.eg.db, ont="BP", minGSSize=10, maxGSSize=1000, pvalueCutoff=0.05, eps=0, verbose=FALSE)
View(EC_gseGO@result)

gseaplot2(EC_gseGO, geneSetID = "GO:0002866", color = "#E495A5", ES_geom = "dot")

save(EC.HTseq.dds, EC.HTseq.gene, file="EC.DEseq.RData")
```

## Over-representative analysis

```{r}
## Mouse
TEC_Up <- filter(DE_gene_table, logFC > 2)
NEC_Up <- filter(DE_gene_table, logFC < -2)

## GO
TEC_enrichGO <- enrichGO(gene=rownames(TEC_Up), keyType="SYMBOL", OrgDb=org.Mm.eg.db, ont="BP", pAdjustMethod="BH", pvalueCutoff=0.01, qvalueCutoff=0.05)
View(TEC_enrichGO@result)

NEC_enrichGO <- enrichGO(gene=rownames(NEC_Up), keyType="SYMBOL", OrgDb=org.Mm.eg.db, ont="BP", pAdjustMethod="BH", pvalueCutoff=0.01, qvalueCutoff=0.05)
View(NEC_enrichGO@result)

```

## Signature Based

```{r}
## PMID: 31292543
## A human liver cell atlas reveals heterogeneity and epithelial progenitors

Aizarani_ms <- read.csv("EC_signatures.csv")
Aizarani_ms$Gene <- paste0(substr(Aizarani_hu$Gene, 1, 1), tolower(substr(Aizarani_hu$Gene, 2, nchar(Aizarani_hu$Gene))))

Aizarani_ms <- Aizarani_ms[Aizarani_ms$Gene %in% rownames(EC.TPM.gene), ]

HTseq.EC.ann$Aizarani_Angiogenesis <- apply(EC.TPM.gene[Aizarani_ms$Gene[Aizarani_ms$Cluster == "EC_06_KDR_ESM1"], ], 2, sum)
HTseq.EC.ann$Aizarani_ECM <- apply(EC.TPM.gene[Aizarani_ms$Gene[Aizarani_ms$Cluster == "EC_03_TFF3"], ], 2, sum)
HTseq.EC.ann$Aizarani_inflammation1 <- apply(EC.TPM.gene[Aizarani_ms$Gene[Aizarani_ms$Cluster == "EC_04_ACKR1"], ], 2, sum)
HTseq.EC.ann$Aizarani_inflammation2 <- apply(EC.TPM.gene[Aizarani_ms$Gene[Aizarani_ms$Cluster == "EC_09_PLCG2"], ], 2, sum)
HTseq.EC.ann$Aizarani_LSEC <- apply(EC.TPM.gene[Aizarani_ms$Gene[Aizarani_ms$Cluster == "EC_01_CLEC4A"], ], 2, sum)

ggplot(HTseq.EC.ann) + geom_point(aes(x=Tissue2, y=Aizarani_LSEC, fill=Tissue, shape=TumorModel), colour="#000000", size=6) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#AC0000","#AC0000", "#57A5E5")) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,22)) + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.border=element_blank(), axis.line.x=element_line(colour="black"), axis.line.y=element_line(colour="black"))

ggplot(HTseq.EC.ann) + geom_point(aes(x=Tissue2, y=Aizarani_ECM, fill=Tissue, shape=TumorModel), colour="#000000", size=6) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#AC0000","#AC0000", "#57A5E5")) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,22)) + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.border=element_blank(), axis.line.x=element_line(colour="black"), axis.line.y=element_line(colour="black"))

ggplot(HTseq.EC.ann) + geom_point(aes(x=Tissue2, y=Aizarani_inflammation1, fill=Tissue, shape=TumorModel), colour="#000000", size=6) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#AC0000","#AC0000", "#57A5E5")) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(21,22)) + theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.border=element_blank(), axis.line.x=element_line(colour="black"), axis.line.y=element_line(colour="black"))
```
